t: This is Guy's Hospital in Southwark, founded in 1721 by Thomas Guy, a merchant and politician who gave the place his name. Today it is an NHS teaching hospital, part of Guy's and St Thomas' and of King's Health Partners. Alice Ayres, the nursemaid honoured for rescuing her nieces from a fire in Southwark, died here, as did the novelist Georgette Heyer and the Labour politician and doctor Alfred Salter. Among those born here are the actress Gemma Chan and the Thai princess Soamsawali.
